name: Jim Blake
profile: Software engineer and co-founder/original CTO of Filevine (founded 2014 with lawyers Ryan Anderson and Nate Morris). Utah Business refers to him as 'the late Jim Blake'; no date of death found.
notes: Deceased per Utah Business (Jan 2026, 'the late Jim Blake'); skip outreach. No obituary or date located.

name: Grace Brown
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, Andromeda (Andromeda Robotics), Melbourne / San Francisco
profile: Brisbane-born mechatronics engineer who, in her mid-20s, founded Andromeda in Melbourne to build Abi, a friendly humanoid companion robot for aged-care and senior-living residents. After a $3M seed (Purpose Ventures) and $23M Series A (incl. Forerunner's Eurie Kim, Main Sequence), Abi is the most-deployed humanoid in Australian aged care and has launched in the US.
interesting_fact: She came up with Abi during Melbourne's long COVID lockdowns, when she felt isolated and 'wanted something to talk to'; the company's stated mission is 'zero loneliness'.
deep_cut_fact: She has been building robots since age 15, and deferred her master's in mechatronics engineering at the University of Melbourne to start Andromeda in 2022 (first cheque: $120k from Startmate); she was on Forbes Australia's inaugural 30 Under 30.
notes: Media-friendly (BBC, ABC, Forbes Australia 30 Under 30, AFR, How I Made It podcast). Hurun lists $2B valuation; company's own news page cites $100M at an earlier stage - newer round not verified. Hurun also lists Yan Chen and Tasnim Ahmed as Andromeda founders, but they do not appear on Andromeda Robotics' team page or press (which credit Brown alone) - the Hurun entry may conflate companies.

name: Daragh Murphy
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, Imprint (co-branded credit cards), New York
profile: Founder of Imprint, a technology-first issuer of co-branded credit cards for brands such as H-E-B, Shell, Brooks Brothers, Eddie Bauer, Westgate and Turkish Airlines. Imprint has raised over $200M in equity from Thrive, Kleiner Perkins, Ribbit and Khosla, plus large credit facilities (e.g. $500M with Mizuho, Truist and HSBC).
interesting_fact: Imprint built its own credit-card ledger and core, rewards platform and ML risk engine instead of using legacy processors, and was named to Forbes' Next Billion-Dollar Startups and 2025 Fintech 50 lists.
deep_cut_fact: Announcing Imprint's $75M round led by Ribbit Capital, he wrote: 'Building Imprint has been my life's work', and said he hires people who are 'courageous and ambitious' with 'an exceptionally-high bar'.
notes: No published press email found on imprint.co; press releases go via Business Wire/PR Newswire. Personal background (pre-Imprint career) not verified - web search quota exhausted.

name: Gaurav Sachdeva
current_role: Joint Managing Director & CEO, JSW One Platforms (Mumbai)
profile: Leads JSW One Platforms, the JSW Group's tech-led B2B marketplace for steel, cement and building materials for Indian MSMEs, with fintech/NBFC and logistics arms. It reached a $1B valuation in May 2025 (₹340 Cr round led by Principal AMC, OneUp, JSW Steel), later raised ₹575 Cr incl. SBI, and has published IPO offer documents.
interesting_fact: JSW One hit unicorn status about four years after launch, a 3x valuation jump from its April 2023 round with Japan's Mitsui & Co.; it calls itself India's largest steel-selling platform.
notes: Company is preparing an IPO (offer documents on corporate site), so communications may be restricted. Chairman is Parth Jindal. Personal background not verified (search quota exhausted).
